description:
*NEW TO THE MARKET*

This 5 bed 3 bath dormer bungalow located along the Cavan Road, Ballinagh is a superior property to come to the market.  Situated within walking distance of all amenities Ballinagh town has to offer this house has huge potential.  The property has ample parking with its own private driveway and large well manicured gardens to the front and the rear. 

The downstairs accommodation is made up of an entrance porch, entrance hall, large open plan sitting room, living room with dining area, kitchen, utility, storage closet, 3 double bedrooms one of which is ensuite, 1 single bedroom, a spacious family bathroom with a bath and a fully accessible shower.  There are feature fireplaces with solid fuel stoves in both the sitting room and the living room.  Upstairs off the landing is another spacious double bedroom with an ensuite and a walk in closet and the rest of the attic space is currently used for storage but has lots of potential.  There is a detached garage to the side of the property also.  

The house is a stones throw from the Local Link Bus Stop servicing Cavan Town and the street lit pedestrian footpath makes all the local amenities which Ballinagh has to offer extremely convenient such as supermarkets, primary school, pre-school and afterschool, churches, chemist, hairdressers, barbers, public houses, butchers, restaurants, takeaways and GAA grounds but to name a few.

Thanks to its extremely convenient location this home would suit a wide variety of potential customers.

VIEWING HIGHLY RECOMMENDED AND STRICTLY BY APPOINTMENT WITH AUCTIONEER ONLY.
